description:
Returns one of the 64 Zhouyi (I Ching) hexagrams by "hexagram" number: trigrams, lines, and the judgement text (and one line text if asked) as printed in an edition with a preface dated 1591, each column with its archive page locator. Text not confirmed against a second copy is withheld.

The English meaning is AI-written and labelled; no human scholar has checked it. Quote the text with its locator.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

hexagram.description: Hexagram number in the received order, 1-64. Example: "11".

line.description: A line, 1 (bottom) to 6 (top), to add its text. Example: "2".

name: get_iching_hexagram_text
title: I Ching hexagram text, cited
